info.title: CISLIB Central Management API
info.description: Authenticated Central Management with nineteen fixed configuration operations alongside thirteen existing APIs. Installed feature discovery reflects actual initialized backend capabilities; specifications do not imply all handlers are enabled. Runtime configuration does not renew managed-work authority. Additive bounded application queries, authorized environment enumeration and metadata-only application configuration definitions preserve existing omitted-filter clients.
